audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and the whys text: L1 was 'Skill' where the text gives it to Yorick, L3 was Yorick where the text calls it 'a clean Illaoi window', Level 6 was 'Skill' where the text says Maiden favours Yorick, and 2+ items was Yorick where the text calls it skill-based.
audit.why: The lane is a 50.15% coin flip over 1023 games with two sharp swings inside it: your level 3 window before Eulogy of the Isles exists, and his level 6 once it does.
audit.corrected: L1-L2 Yorick, L3 Illaoi, Levels 4-5 skill, Level 6 and first item Yorick, 2+ items skill. diff moved HARD to EVEN to match the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Maiden spike had no cooldown attached, so 'all-in early or not at all' gave the player nothing to count.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s — 160 seconds at rank 1 is the longest timer in the lane and makes his Maiden windows countable rather than permanent. Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s at 600 range.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into spikes[0] and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The cage advice said to 'walk to the weakest segment', and Mourning Mist was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's W text says Yorick 'summons a destructible wall' — the counterplay is breaking it, not finding a weak point, and nothing in the data supports segments of differing strength. Riot's E text: it 'reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies' and 'Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets' — the mark on you is what launches the swarm, and it also strips your armour before the trade.
audit.corrected: Cage advice rewritten around destructibility; Mourning Mist added to mid and spikes[0] with its 700 range against your 900 E.

audit.why: Unlike the yasuo and yone pages, anti-heal genuinely applies here — Last Rites heals him on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cooldown. _missing confirms needs-antiheal.
audit.corrected: Reinforced in spikes[2] with the timing: buy it before contesting the Maiden window, not after.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites' auto-attack reset was never flagged.
audit.why: _missing carries autoreset-burst-tell: his damage arrives on the reset auto, so the wind-up is the cue, not the cast. It also digs a grave on every champion hit, which is where the swarm comes from.

edits.before: This is your window: once W Harsh Lesson is up you dash in, land E Test of Spirit, and slam him with Q while his Maiden isn't out yet. Rip his spirit before he can wall you in with W Dark Procession — if he cages you, walk to the weakest segment immediately or you eat free Ghoul autos.
edits.after: This is your window at 3: Test of Spirit reaches 900, further than Mourning Mist (E) at 700 or Dark Procession (W) at 600, and his Maiden is still 160 seconds away. Rip his soul before he walls you in — and if the cage does land, the wall is destructible, so break the nearest segment instead of walking the ring.

edits.before: Yorick's R Eulogy of the Isles summons the Maiden, and her plus a full ghoul pack out-DPS your R tentacle ring in a straight brawl; the extra bodies also body-block your E's soul walk. Only ult if you've already cleared his ghouls, otherwise favour is his.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles (R) is 160s at rank 1 — a huge timer, so his Maiden windows are countable rather than permanent. Her pack out-bodies your tentacle ring and the extra units block the walk to your spirit. Commit Leap of Faith only once the ghouls are cleared.

edits.before: With Maiden up permanently Yorick shoves you in, splitpushes, and his ghoul swarm plus Q healing out-sustains your tentacles in extended fights. Avoid all-ins under his ghoul cap and farm safe.
edits.after: With Maiden up he shoves you in and splitpushes, and Last Rites (Q) heals him every 4 to 6 seconds while the swarm chips. Executioner's Calling earns its gold here — buy it before you contest, not after.

edits.before: Yorick out-stats you at level 1-2 with his Q ghoul poke and passive Ghoul spawns off grave marks; he can chip you and set up a W cage before your W is online. Take short trades, dodge Q, and don't get walled with ghouls around.
edits.after: Yorick owns 1-2: Last Rites (Q) is an auto-attack reset that heals him and digs a grave on every champion hit, so his swarm is built out of you. The wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. Take short trades and never fight beside his graves.

edits.before: Level 3 is your one clean window — W to engage, E to rip his spirit, Q slams before Maiden exists. But by 5-6 his Maiden and ghoul swarm out-body your tentacles, so all-in early or not at all.
edits.after: Level 3 is your one clean window — Harsh Lesson in, Test of Spirit from 900, Q slams, all before Maiden exists. Mourning Mist marks you and speeds his ghouls toward you, so treat that mark as the swarm's starting gun.

edits.before: Break out of W cage on the weak wall segment
edits.after: Break the destructible cage at the nearest wall

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Dark Procession and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Dark Procession and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Yorick carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Yorick carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Level 3 is your clean window and level 6 is his. See the chart for the swing points.

notes: Mourning Mist (E) was absent from the entire page despite being the ability that strips your armour and sends the ghoul pack at you — the mark is the tell for the swarm. Also removed 'walk to the weakest segment' of the cage: Riot's text says the wall is destructible, and nothing supports segments of differing strength. Anti-heal is correct in this matchup (unlike yasuo/yone, where the same boilerplate line was wrong).
